neighbours.label: the piece '-scale' in compounds such as 'large-scale' / 'small-scale'
fire: The report warns that large-scale farming has reduced the variety of seeds in use.
Loans are offered to small-scale fishermen along the coast at low interest.
Engineers are planning a full-scale test of the new bridge design next spring.
The charity mainly helps mid-scale producers find buyers for their crops.
Officials fear a large-scale outbreak if the vaccine supply runs out.
She studies how small-scale traders in the market set their prices.
The company is moving from pilot runs to large-scale production this year.
Critics say the plan ignores the needs of small-scale growers in the hills.
quiet: The report warns that industrial farming has reduced the variety of seeds in use.
Loans are offered to local fishermen along the coast at low interest.
Engineers are planning a complete test of the new bridge design next spring.
The charity mainly helps family producers find buyers for their crops.
Officials fear a widespread outbreak if the vaccine supply runs out.
She studies how independent traders in the market set their prices.
The company is moving from pilot runs to mass production this year.
Critics say the plan ignores the needs of poor growers in the hills.
